narrative.arc: Closed cover → PLAY opens the gatefold → the record becomes a world → write the back cover.

beats.title: PRESS PLAY TO OPEN
beats.body: Until PLAY, the record is closed. PLAY opens the gatefold. The camera enters.

beats.title: THE COVER IS A DOOR
beats.body: Scroll is travel. Architecture reveals the next place. Fast is a flip. Slow is a listen.

beats.title: WORKS INSIDE THE RECORD
beats.body: A window, a printed wall, a projection, a sleeve on a table. Hover isolates. OPEN arms that sketch.

beats.title: WHAT SURVIVES THE FOLD
beats.body: Credits on the inner panel. Taste is what remains after the cut.

beats.title: WRITE THE BACK COVER
beats.body: Leases, exclusives, sessions, sync. HTML if the world goes dark.

tapes.title: SILK ON THE 808
tapes.blurb: Velvet pressure. The 808 is the chest, not the drop.

tapes.title: PRESSURE SKETCH 3

tapes.title: AFTERIMAGE CHORDS
tapes.blurb: Slow architecture. Gospel voicings that refuse the one.
tapes.caption: Inner sleeve 3 — Afterimage Chords.

tapes.title: GRID DIG
tapes.blurb: Filtered break, chopped soul, mandatory nod.
